Package com.stzteam.features.advantagekitbridge.internal

Class LogCodec

java.lang.Object
com.stzteam.features.advantagekitbridge.internal.LogCodec
public abstract class LogCodec extends Object
A pre-resolved read/write plan for a single field of a MARS Data class.

One codec is compiled per field the first time a Data class is seen (see LogCodecFactory) and then reused for the lifetime of the program. All the expensive decisions -- which LogTable overload applies, which Struct serialises this type, what the log key is -- are made once, at compile time, so the per-loop cost is a Field access plus one typed LogTable call. The primitive codecs use Field.getDouble and friends specifically to avoid boxing a value per field per subsystem per cycle, which on a roboRIO is the difference between a quiet heap and a GC pause mid-match.
